[Nov 17, 2026](https://jitter.video/changelog/2026-11-17-counter-templates/)


# Template collection: Counters


Today's drop is a set of 8 counter templates for showing off any number that matters: milestones, stats, countdowns, percentages, and more. From halftone posters and pixel grids to glitch effects and progress rings, use these to celebrate wins, count down to launches, or turn any stat into something worth stopping for.[Explore the new templates here](https://jitter.video/templates/counters/) .


## Other improvements


- Smarter AI briefs: When you give the AI an open-ended request, it may now ask a few quick questions to build a short creative brief before generating. Answer them to get results closer to what you have in mind, or skip them to jump straight in.
- PNG resolution options: You can now copy or download scenes as PNGs at 1×, 2×, or 3×.
- Better Figma imports: Group layer blur and blend modes now carry over more accurately when importing from Figma.
- More MCP controls: If you use Jitter through the MCP, your connected assistant can now find your workspaces and list, create, rename, or delete folders.


[View all updates](https://jitter.video/changelog/)
